title: Small good subsets with a controlled intersection
statement: Use the universe, regularity, presentability, weak saturation and tree definitions in [lem-coef-weak-saturation-tree-presentation]. Fix infinite regular cardinals $\kappa<\tau$, with $\tau$ uncountable and $a^b<\tau$ for all cardinals $a<\tau$ and $b<\kappa$. Let $\mathcal A$ be an ordinary locally $\tau$-presentable category with small Hom sets. Let $C,W$ be arrow classes, with $C$ and $C\cap W$ weakly saturated. Suppose $W$ is closed under isomorphism of arrows, has two-out-of-three for composable arrows, and has the following approximation property: for every small $\tau$-filtered poset $P$, every diagram $p\mapsto f_p$ of arrows with $\tau$-presentable sources and targets whose colimit in the arrow category lies in $W$, and every subset $E\subseteq P$ of size less than $\tau$, there is a subset $Q\subseteq P$ containing $E$, with $|Q|<\tau$, which is $\kappa$-filtered in its inherited order and whose arrow colimit belongs to $W$. Here two-out-of-three means that membership of two of $f,g,gf$ implies membership of the third. Let $L\subseteq C$ have $\tau$-presentable sources and targets and let a $\tau$-good $L$-tree with root $X$ be given, indexed by $T$, with $X\to Y_T$ in $W$. Call a subset $B\subseteq T$ good when it is downward-closed and $X\to Y_B$ belongs to $W$. For every good $A_0\subseteq T$ and every subset $B_0\subseteq T$ of size less than $\tau$, there exists a good $B\subseteq T$ with $|B|<\tau$ containing $B_0$, such that $B\cap A_0$ is good as well.
